name: Flimflam Man
subtitle: riveting!
rules: When this card enters play, you may choose a card type. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck. If it is the chosen type, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: "...a huge, gargantuan, swollen, bloated, mushroom!"

name: Gambling Den
subtitle: smart money's on the cobra
rules: At the start of your turn, reveal the top card of your deck. If it has numeric cost 3 or less, each player may draw a card. Otherwise, each player may play a resource.
flavor: Poking it's a single, stroking it's a double. To get a triple... well, let's just say you don't use your hands.
notes: Rarity prints UNCOMMON; catalog says rare.

name: Guttersnipe
subtitle: i will come to your house and i will cut you
rules: TACTICAL -- FLIP UP – 0 [D][D]

name: Harbinger of Anguish
subtitle: shall we tell the truth then, you and I? no more lies?
rules: DEMOTIVATE -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 1 life.

name: Headhunting
subtitle: it kinda tickles
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only in response to a character with numeric cost X or less being deployed, where X is number of [D] you control. -- The character enters play under your control.
flavor: in a PLEASE GET OFF ME kinda way

name: Heist Training Grounds
subtitle: if you die here, you'd die twice out there
rules: UNIQUE HEIST TRAINING GROUNDS -- [D][D][D] – At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, it gains COVERT this turn. -- [D][D][D][D][D] – At the start of your turn, you may search an opponent's deck for a card. If you do, put it into their discard pile. -- [D][D][D][D][D][D][D] – At the start of your turn, an opponent discards a card at random.

name: Hidden Dagger
subtitle: you can't see it if it's shiny
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- TACTICAL -- The attached character gains 1 strength. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character. -- FLIP UP – 1 [D]
flavor: Not before it's too late, anyway.

name: Hustler's Comeuppance
subtitle: never con a con-man, especially when he's better than you
rules: Destroy all characters that inflicted damage to your faction this turn. -- FLIP UP – 3 [D][D]
flavor: "But I love my hands! That's where my fingers live!"

name: Hypnotic Illusionist
subtitle: the piper will be paid
rules: HYPNOTIZE -- COST – Pay 5. Destroy this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Take control of the character if it has numeric cost X or less, where X is the number of [D] you control.

name: I Drink Your Milkshake!
subtitle: it will bring boys to my yard
rules: You may search an opponent's deck for a card. If you do, put it in the void face-down. For the rest of the game, when that opponent deploys a card, you may reveal the voided card if it has the same name. If you do, you may deploy it for free even if you cannot meet its threshold. If you deploy it, terminate the opponent's card. (Playing a resource does not trigger this effect.)
flavor: But do I really want them?
notes: Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by Lioge'.

name: Lecram, Silent Advisor
rules: COVERT, UNIQUE LECRAM -- At the start of your turn, you may look at the top card of your deck. -- At the end of your turn, flip a coin. If you win, look at the top card of an opponent's deck.
notes: Subtitle is '...' and the flavor line at the bottom of the text box is also '...'.

name: Lucky Bastard
subtitle: and that was without a single drop of rum
rules: When this card enters play, draw a card. -- If this card would be destroyed, each player removes the top card of their deck from the game instead. If the numeric cost of your removed card is greater than or equal to the numeric cost of each opponents', draw a card and reduce the amount of damage already inflicted to this card this turn to 0. Otherwise, remove this card from the game.
notes: Card prints 'each opponents'' where catalog says 'all opponent's'; same play.

name: Lucky Charm
subtitle: they're tragically malicious
rules: When this card enters play, draw a card. -- Your opponents must pay 1 to pick a character you control.
flavor: I've never lost at Hat-Sheep-Banana, and I don't intend to start now.

name: Luxurious Gaming Establishment
subtitle: kick back and stay a while
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, it loses 1 speed this turn.
flavor: Where the music stinks, and they water the drinks. Where the girlies dance in their underpants. Where you see their butt, and their trap stays shut.

name: Maxwell Cockswagger
subtitle: O lay!
rules: UNIQUE MAXWELL -- STRUT -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 speed or loses 1 life.

name: Mistaken Identity
subtitle: breathe the wall. be the wall.
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only in response to a card or ability that picked a character as a cost. Pick another character that could be picked by that card or ability. -- When the card or ability resolves, its effect happens as though your opponent had picked the other character instead.
notes: Card says 'picked a character as a cost'; catalog says 'as an extra cost' (narrower: would exclude ability COST picks). Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by Lekkit'.

name: Muddle Bugs
subtitle: hey man
rules: BINGE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put a token on the character. Destroy it if it has at least X tokens on it, where X is its numeric cost.
flavor: You got any more of that muddle bug?

name: Muscle Tribe of Danger and Excellence
rules: When a card that provides at least [D] enters play under your control, this card gains 1 strength and COVERT this turn.
flavor: "I don't care if you're pregnant...that's a threesome as far as I can tell!"
notes: Name wraps to two lines; no subtitle line.

name: Mustache Aficionado
subtitle: Movember Champions
rules: MUSTACHE SHOWDOWN -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – You and an opponent look at the top 3 cards of your decks and divide them into 2 face-down piles containing at least 1 card each. Each of you choose one of their opponent's piles. Reveal the chosen piles. If one pile has a higher total numeric cost than the other, the owner of that pile may put one of the cards from it into their hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into their owner's deck.
flavor: Luxurious facial hair is no laughing matter.
notes: Catalog typo "owners's deck"; card prints "owner's deck". Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by Nurgleprobe'.

name: Narrow Passage
subtitle: the perfect place for an ambush
rules: Players can attack only once each turn.

name: Obtuse Pipesmoker
subtitle: dazed and confused
rules: [D][D][D][D][D] – This card gains 1 strength, 1 life, and 1 speed.
flavor: "Ugggh...ohhh yeah...I feel my second wind coming on..."

name: Opportune Slotpuller
subtitle: so...happy...but...can't...breathe...
rules: GAMBLE -- COST – Pay 1. Choose a card type. -- EFFECT – Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is the chosen type, this card gains 2 strength and loses 1 life this turn. Put the top card of your deck on the bottom.
flavor: Or...speak...at...normal...rate.

name: Overindulge
subtitle: do a little dance. drink a little booze. get down tonight.
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- This turn, the character loses 2 life. -- OPTION 2 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 1 life. Draw a card.

name: Palm Glom
subtitle: I always wanted an extra hand
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character or item. -- Take control of the character or item. Draw a card.
flavor: Can now steal from extra-distance.

name: Pant Swipe
subtitle: it ain't stealing if you take it fast
rules: Put the top 4 cards of an opponent's deck into the void face-down. (You are still allowed to look at them.) -- For the rest of the game, you may deploy the voided cards as though they were in your hand even if you cannot meet their threshold. -- FLIP UP – 5 [D][D][D]

name: Party Clowns
subtitle: get down with the clown
rules: You may include as many copies of this card in your deck as you want. -- At the start of your turn, you may pay 1. If you do, search your deck for a card named "Party Clowns" and reveal it. Put it into play under your control.
flavor: There ain't no party like a party clown party cuz a party clown party don't stop.

name: Peculate
subtitle: to purloin public purses or property
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character, item, or location in an opponent's discard pile. Pay X, where X is its numeric cost. -- Put the card into play under your control.

name: Pit Boss
subtitle: severed ear! house takes all.
rules: This card gains 1 speed for each [D] you control.
flavor: The casino controls the croupier, the croupier controls the game.

name: Resistance Fighter
subtitle: we're no lynch mob...
rules: PROVIDES – [D] -- While you control a character you don't own, this card gains 2 strength, 2 life, and 1 speed.
flavor: We're freedom fighters from the future.
notes: Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by kallisti'.

name: Rigged Tables
subtitle: double zeroes again?! AGAIN?!
rules: SIZE UP -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at the top card of any deck. -- RIG -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Put the top card of any deck on the bottom. -- WALK AWAY -- COST – Pay 1. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.

name: Rosy Palmer, and Her Five Friends
rules: UNIQUE ROSY -- When this card is destroyed, reveal the top 5 cards of an opponent's deck. You may choose a revealed character. If you do, put it into play under your control. That player puts the remaining cards on the bottom of their deck in any order.
flavor: 6 naked ladies...woah man, that's TOO MUCH!
notes: Name wraps to two lines; no subtitle line.

name: Roulette Wheel of DOOM!
subtitle: who wants to play?
rules: Reveal the top card of your deck. You may pick a character with X life or less, where X is the numeric cost of the revealed card. If you do, destroy that character. Otherwise, draw 2 cards.
flavor: Always bet on death!

name: Roundalicious Breasticles
subtitle: "is it my birthday?"
rules: At the end of your turn, put a token on this card. -- JIGGLE JIGGLE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- TANTALIZE -- COST – Pick a character with numeric cost X or less, where X is the number of tokens on this card. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Take control of the character.

name: Rumply Ruse
subtitle: works every time
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only during a battle. -- This turn, all characters in your party gain 1 speed. -- FLIP UP – 4 [D][D]
flavor: The old moon-and-trip-on-the-covered-hole trick. That's the second time I've fallen for that this month.

name: Rusty Pickaxe
subtitle: notched to perfection
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 1 strength and 1 life. -- If this card would be destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead. -- FLIP UP – 1 [D]
flavor: The invention of the pickaxe was groundbreaking.

name: Shadowy Mugger
subtitle: that guy's been standing there for over an hour
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, you may search an opponent's deck for a card. If you do, put it into their discard pile.

name: Slinking Bandido
subtitle: which way did she go? which way did she go?
rules: COVERT -- When this card inflicts damage to a faction, put a token on this card. -- This card gains 1 strength for each token on it.

name: Sly Bilker
subtitle: duuude...you should totally bet
rules: SIZE UP -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Look at the top card of either deck.
flavor: "That's a mighty fine hook you've got there."

name: Smothering Corpulence
subtitle: that's how i want to go
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character an opponent controls. You and that character's controller remove the top card of your decks from the game. X is the numeric cost of that player's removed card minus the numeric cost of your removed card. -- This turn, the character loses X life. Draw a card.

name: Sprint
subtitle: she was hot. it would have been wrong not to hit it.
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- This turn, the character gains 1 speed. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.
flavor: You don't plan sincerity, you've gotta make it up on the spot.

name: Strangulate
subtitle: the price of good fortune
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- If the character has 4 life or less, destroy it. -- FLIP UP – 2 [D]

name: Surprise!
subtitle: we're here to relieve you of your possessions
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character attacking your faction or a location you control. X is that character's numeric cost. -- Reveal cards from the top of your deck until a character with numeric cost X or less is revealed or no cards are left. If an appropriate character is revealed, put it into play under your control as a member of the blocking party. Shuffle all other revealed cards into your deck.

name: Swollen Ostrich
subtitle: ahh! ohh! there's my trick knee.
rules: TACTICAL -- When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, it gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn. -- FLIP UP – 1 [D][D]

name: Titillating Contortionist
subtitle: do you see it yet?
rules: When this card attacks, you may pick a character. If you do, it must block this card if it can this turn.
flavor: "Not yet. Keep contorting."

name: Transient Smuggler
subtitle: quit hogging the covers!
rules: SMUGGLE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character with 2 strength or less. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT.
